## Checklist
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry under **Unreleased**
- [ ] Facts come from a primary source (linked below), and the OutSystems UI version (Classic / 3.0 / both) is stated
- [ ] New rule IDs are defined in `references/review-checklist.md` (or `lessons-learned.md`)
- [ ] `adapters/core-rules.md` and `adapters/copilot-instructions.md` kept in sync (if an always-on rule changed)
- [ ] No client names, internal URLs, credentials or real-app screenshots
